text.text: Nobody had claimed coordinating dinner on Thursday, Oct 22, so Dinnerbell picked you at random from everyone who's in. While the vote is open, you can tap *Lock this* on a pick to decide it, break a tie, shuffle the picks, or make a takeout pick pickup or delivery with ⋯ beside it. Once it's decided, you can change how you get it and who does it. If that isn't clear, you'll be asked to choose. If you don't within 15 minutes, or by the meal time if that's sooner, the first person who offered does it, if anyone did. If it doesn't suit you, hand it off to someone who's in on the call's page. Thanks for steering!
